dict.string: For guards: Crew Hours clocks you in when you get to the guard shack and out when you leave, even with the app closed. It only watches for the shack; it does not track where you go.
Crew Hours uses your location only while you record a drive, to tick off the roads you drive and save your route. It keeps recording with the phone locked until you tap Save track.
Crew Hours uses the camera so you can take photos of jobs, leaks and receipts.
Crew Hours lets you pick photos of jobs, leaks and receipts from your library.
Crew Hours doesn't record sound, but your phone asks when a video is taken with the camera.
